dashboard.definition:
{
  "title": "Confused Deputy",
  "description": "WS-MCP-006 Dashboard Studio workshop. Reuses validated Q-MCP investigation SPL plus Q-MCP-DELEGATION. Saved search DET-MCP-001 is packaged disabled; this dashboard does not enable it. No DET-MCP-006. Splunk does not ALLOW or DENY a deputy call.",
  "defaults": {
    "visualizations": {
      "splunk.table": {
        "options": {
          "backgroundColor": "#FFFFFF",
          "headerBackgroundColor": "#0B1F33",
          "headerTextColor": "#FFFFFF"
        }
      },
      "splunk.markdown": {
        "options": {
          "fontColor": "#17202A",
          "fontSize": "large"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "inputs": {
    "input_run_id": {
      "type": "input.dropdown",
      "title": "Investigate specimen",
      "options": {
        "token": "run_id",
        "defaultValue": "1cf98c4d-1bd8-4df5-be70-b82419e2c2b2",
        "items": [
          {
            "label": "Baseline — defended / normal",
            "value": "1cf98c4d-1bd8-4df5-be70-b82419e2c2b2"
          },
          {
            "label": "Attack — vulnerable / malicious",
            "value": "d7524a4e-8da6-4171-8867-d2a2168128ac"
          },
          {
            "label": "Retest — defended / malicious",
            "value": "50f7ec04-7524-41c0-95a8-3b1ef4d91dc4"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "dataSources": {
    "ds_q_who": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-WHO",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval principal=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.principal.id'),0)
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval method=mvindex(mvdedup('mcp.method.name'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| table run_id, principal, agent, tool, method, profile, mode"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_authz": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-AUTHZ",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval attempted=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.attempted'),0)
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, control_id, decision, reason, requested_scope, allowed_scope, attempted, executed, outcome"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_tool": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-TOOL",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, event_name, sequence, executed, outcome
| sort sequence"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_executed": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-EXECUTED",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eval is_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| eval is_failed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.failed",1,0)
| eventstats max(is_started) as has_started, max(is_completed) as has_completed, max(is_failed) as has_failed by run_id, tool
| where event_name="agentsec.control.decision"
| eval execution_state=case(has_completed=1,"mcp.completed",has_failed=1,"mcp.failed",has_started=1,"mcp.started",decision="ALLOW","ALLOW_execution_not_proven_in_this_copy",1=1,"no_mcp_execution_event")
| table run_id, tool, decision, executed, outcome, has_started, has_completed, has_failed, execution_state"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_after_deny": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-AFTER-DENY",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_mcp=if(match(event_name,"^agentsec\\.mcp\\."),1,0)
| eventstats min(eval(if(is_deny=1,sequence,null()))) as deny_seq, max(is_deny) as has_deny by run_id, tool
| where has_deny=1 AND is_mcp=1 AND sequence>deny_seq
| table run_id, tool, deny_seq, sequence, event_name, decision"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_delegation": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-DELEGATION",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval hop=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.hop.index'),0)
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)
| eval principal=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.principal.id'),0)
| eval delegator=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.delegator.agent.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval authority_source=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.delegation.authority.source'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval resource_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.resource.id'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval caller=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",agent,null())
| eval deputy=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001",agent,null())
| eval hop1_delegator=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001",delegator,null())
| eval delegation_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",decision,null())
| eval delegation_reason=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",reason,null())
| eval delegation_authority_source=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",authority_source,null())
| eval requested_tool=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",tool,null())
| eval requested_scope_h0=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",requested_scope,null())
| eval requested_resource=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",resource_id,null())
| eval coded_delegated_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-DELEGATION-001",allowed_scope,null())
| eval mcp_decision=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001",decision,null())
| eval mcp_reason=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001",reason,null())
| eval mcp_allowed_scope=if(control_id="CTRL-MCP-001",allowed_scope,null())
| eval mcp_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eval mcp_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| eval mcp_failed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.failed",1,0)
| eventstats values(caller) as caller, values(deputy) as deputy, values(hop1_delegator) as hop1_delegator, values(delegation_decision) as delegation_decision, values(delegation_reason) as delegation_reason, values(delegation_authority_source) as delegation_authority_source, values(requested_tool) as requested_tool, values(requested_scope_h0) as requested_scope_h0, values(requested_resource) as requested_resource, values(coded_delegated_scope) as coded_delegated_scope, values(mcp_decision) as mcp_decision, values(mcp_reason) as mcp_reason, values(mcp_allowed_scope) as mcp_allowed_scope, max(mcp_started) as has_started, max(mcp_completed) as has_completed, max(mcp_failed) as has_failed, latest(profile) as profile, latest(mode) as mode, latest(principal) as principal by run_id
| eval caller=mvindex(mvdedup(caller),0)
| eval deputy=mvindex(mvdedup(deputy),0)
| eval hop1_delegator=mvindex(mvdedup(hop1_delegator),0)
| eval delegation_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(delegation_decision),0)
| eval delegation_reason=mvindex(mvdedup(delegation_reason),0)
| eval delegation_authority_source=mvindex(mvdedup(delegation_authority_source),0)
| eval requested_tool=mvindex(mvdedup(requested_tool),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(requested_scope_h0),0)
| eval requested_resource=mvindex(mvdedup(requested_resource),0)
| eval coded_delegated_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(coded_delegated_scope),0)
| eval mcp_decision=mvindex(mvdedup(mcp_decision),0)
| eval mcp_reason=mvindex(mvdedup(mcp_reason),0)
| eval mcp_allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup(mcp_allowed_scope),0)
| eval deputy_observation=if(isnull(deputy) OR deputy="","deputy_not_on_indexed_hop1",deputy)
| eval mcp_decision_observation=if(isnull(mcp_decision) OR mcp_decision="","no_downstream_mcp_control_event",mcp_decision)
| eval execution_observation=case(has_completed=1,"mcp.completed_observed",has_failed=1,"mcp.failed_observed",has_started=1,"mcp.started_observed",1=1,"no_indexed_mcp_execution_event")
| where isnotnull(delegation_decision) AND delegation_decision!=""
| dedup run_id
| table run_id, profile, mode, principal, caller, deputy_observation, hop1_delegator, requested_tool, requested_scope, requested_resource, coded_delegated_scope, delegation_authority_source, delegation_decision, delegation_reason, mcp_decision_observation, mcp_reason, mcp_allowed_scope, execution_observation"
      }
    },
    "ds_det_mcp_001_sim": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "DET-MCP-001-POSITIVE-CONTROL",
      "options": {
        "query": "| makeresults count=2
| streamstats count as row

| eval "agentsec.run.id"="simulated-det-mcp-001-0001"

| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)

| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval trace_id=mvindex(mvdedup('trace_id'),0)
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eventstats min(eval(if(is_deny=1,sequence,null()))) as deny_sequence, max(is_deny) as has_deny, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,agent,null()))) as agent, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,principal,null()))) as principal, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,control_id,null()))) as control_id, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,profile,null()))) as profile, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,mode,null()))) as mode, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,requested_scope,null()))) as requested_scope, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,allowed_scope,null()))) as allowed_scope, latest(eval(if(is_started=1,trace_id,null()))) as start_trace_id by run_id, tool
| eval trace_id=coalesce(start_trace_id,trace_id)
| where has_deny=1 AND is_started=1 AND sequence>deny_sequence
| eval decision="DENY"
| eval mcp_start_sequence=sequence
| table run_id, tool, agent, principal, control_id, decision, deny_sequence, mcp_start_sequence, profile, mode, requested_scope, allowed_scope, trace_id, evidence_class"
      }
    },
